subject: AP: Onboarding — invoice submission guidelines, fallback behavior & template variants
messages:

Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the invite to get ApexCloud set up with Redwood's AP flow. Our billing team wanted to confirm a couple of details before we complete the supplier form:

1) Is the preferred ingestion channel the vendor portal only, or do you support a structured email fallback (subject token + PDF/CSV) for a short period after go-live?
2) For email fallback, what specific subject line tokens or attachment filename conventions do you require so your parser can auto-match to a PO?
3) Do you accept consolidated invoices (single file with multiple POs/lines) or do you prefer one invoice per PO for faster PO-stamping?

I've attached our internal billing template — we can adapt if needed.

Goal: we want to go live the week of 3/23 but need to know if we should prioritize portal SSO onboarding or continue using our email pipeline.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Finance Operations, ApexCloud Solutions
priya@apexcloud.com

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Priya — welcome, and thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, then details and recommended next steps.

Summary:
- Primary channel: Redwood Vendor Portal (strongly recommended). It provides better PO mapping, auto-ack, and tracing in our Console.
- Short-term fallback: yes — we support an email ingestion path for 30 days after go-live while you finish SSO provisioning.
- For email fallback: use the subject token: REDW-PO:{PO_NUMBER} (e.g., REDW-PO:450123), or include a header file named po-<PONUMBER>.json inside a .zip. Filenames alone are also parsed if they include PO or INV tokens.
- Template: we accept both consolidated CSV (one file with a PO column + line items) and single-invoice PDFs. Consolidated CSV is preferred if you have multiple POs in one delivery; it speeds GL allocation. If you send PDFs, one invoice per PDF is easier for our PO-stamping rules.

Best practice (recommended go-live flow):
1) Complete portal SSO + supplier form (attached): this enables automatic PO matching.
2) For the first 30 days, use email fallback address invoices@redwood.com with the subject token (REDW-PO:####). Include invoice PDF + optional CSV with line-level detail.
3) After 30 days we will disable email ingestion for the vendor; all invoices should come through the portal.

I've attached the AP_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf (fillable) and a sample invoice-template-examples.csv with two variants: consolidated-lines and single-invoice-per-PO. Marissa is looping in for the template examples and parser rules.

If you're comfortable with this plan we can schedule a 20-minute SSO handoff on Tue 3/23.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question (template details + PO-stamping rules)

Hi Priya — hi all, quick technical notes from AP intake and our parser team. Keeping this tight so your engineering/billing team can map fields.

Parser requirements (email fallback):
- Subject token: REDW-PO:{PO_NUMBER} or include header line in the email body exactly: PO: {PO_NUMBER}. If both are present, subject token takes precedence.
- Attachment rules: we parse PDF, CSV, XLSX. If you send a ZIP, include a manifest.txt with filenames and the PO number.

CSV schema (columns we map automatically):
- vendor_name, vendor_tax_id, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_number, item_description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, total_line_amount, currency

Accepted invoice behaviors:
- Consolidated CSV: one file with multiple po_number rows is supported and recommended if you have many small shipments. It will be ingested as separate invoices per po_number and routed to the matching PO(s).
- Single-invoice PDFs: if you attach multiple PDFs in one email, we will process each separately; ensure the PDF filename includes either INV or PO token (e.g., INV-20260314-1123.pdf or PO-450123.pdf).

PO stamping & exception handling:
- If the PO matches and line totals reconcile within a 2% variance, the invoice auto-stamps and moves to payment queue.
- If variance >2% or missing line-level matches, it routes to exception workflow and we will notify both vendor+buyer with expected SLA 3 business days to resolve.

Sample CSV (attached) includes two exemplar rows and a consolidated example. I'll drop the sample payload into the Drive link Grace shared.

If you want, we can run a test ingest — please send a test email to invoices+test@redwood.com with the subject: REDW-PO:TEST-000 and attach the CSV from the email. We'll provide ingestion logs within 1 hour.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
